verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS platform that ships a CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking in the CLI, SDK or dashboard. The closest item is HIPAA mode's control over how call recordings and logs are stored (vapi-docs-55), but that governs customer call-data retention, not vendor telemetry, so it is not credited.
